title: Watchers: pause, resume, export and import, the counter, and they carry on after a restart

steps.why: The Agent screen shows the watchers button

steps.js: const w = Watch.list().find(x => x.name === 'Lifecycle mail'); const d = Watch.exportDef(w), def = d.watcher || d; Watch.import({ ...def, name: 'Lifecycle copy' }, { auto: true, quiet: true }); return Watch.list().some(x => x.name === 'Lifecycle copy')
steps.why: Export it and import the copy

steps.js: (Watch.list().find(w => w.name === 'Lifecycle mail')?.state?.at || 0) > Date.now() - 120000 || Watch.list().find(w => w.name === 'Lifecycle mail')?.state?.next > 0
